phases.name: Base
phases.description: Build swim fitness with technique focus and gradually increasing session volume
phases.focus: Stroke efficiency, breathing rhythm, and base endurance
phases.coachNote: Technique over speed. Every stroke should be long and smooth. Count strokes per length and try to reduce while maintaining pace.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Introduce speed intervals and extend continuous swim distance
phases.focus: CSS pace development and threshold endurance
phases.coachNote: Speed work at CSS pace or slightly faster. Focus on holding consistent splits across all repeats. Rest should be active — float or easy kick.

phases.name: Peak
phases.description: Race-specific training at 1500m pace with longest continuous swims
phases.focus: Race pace endurance and pacing strategy for 1500m
phases.coachNote: Longer intervals at CSS pace simulate the fatigue of the full 1500m. Practice bilateral breathing for open water sighting.

phases.name: Taper
phases.description: Reduce volume, sharpen with short fast efforts
phases.focus: Freshness, speed sharpening, and race readiness
phases.coachNote: Volume drops ~40%. Short, fast efforts keep feel for the water. Rest more than you think you need.

Tue.name: Technique & Drills
Tue.description: 200m warmup + 600m drills (catch-up, fingertip drag, fist drill) + 200m easy swim + 200m cooldown
Tue.coachNote: Focus on one drill per session. Quality over quantity. Smooth, long strokes.

Thu.name: Endurance Swim
Thu.description: 200m warmup + 4×200m steady pace (30sec rest) + 200m kick + 200m cooldown
Thu.coachNote: Steady pace across all 200m sets. Use the rest to focus on breathing recovery.

Sat.name: Long Swim
Sat.description: 200m warmup + 400m continuous swim (easy) + 200m kick + 400m continuous swim + 200m drills + 200m cooldown
Sat.coachNote: Build toward continuous swimming. The 400m blocks are your foundation. Breathe every 3 strokes.

Tue.name: Speed Intervals
Tue.description: 300m warmup + 10×100m @CSS (2:00/100m) with 20sec rest + 200m easy + 100m kick + 200m cooldown
Tue.coachNote: Early build: 8×100m. Late build: 12×100m. Hold consistent pace on every 100m. If form breaks down, reduce reps.

Thu.name: Threshold Swim
Thu.description: 200m warmup + 4×200m @CSS (2:00/100m) with 30sec rest + 200m easy + 200m drills + 200m cooldown
Thu.coachNote: CSS pace should feel hard but sustainable. These 200m repeats are your most important session — they build race-specific endurance.

Sat.name: Long Swim + Pace Work
Sat.description: 300m warmup + 800m continuous swim (easy-mod) + 4×50m fast (1:50/100m) with 30sec rest + 200m kick + 200m easy + 300m cooldown
Sat.coachNote: The 800m block builds your continuous swim base. The fast 50s at the end simulate finishing speed when tired.

Tue.name: CSS Intervals
Tue.description: 300m warmup + 5×200m @CSS (2:00/100m) with 30sec rest + 200m easy + 100m kick + 300m cooldown
Tue.coachNote: Longer intervals at CSS pace. Hold form on the last rep — that's where the race is won.

Thu.name: Pace Pyramid
Thu.description: 200m warmup + 100m fast + 200m @CSS + 300m @CSS + 200m @CSS + 100m fast (30sec rest between) + 200m easy + 200m kick + 300m cooldown
Thu.coachNote: The pyramid builds then tapers intensity. The fast 100s at each end simulate race start and finish.

Sat.name: Long Continuous Swim
Sat.description: 300m warmup + 1200m continuous swim + 200m kick + 8×50m descending pace (2:05→1:50/100m) with 20sec rest + 300m cooldown
Sat.coachNote: Week 9: 1200m continuous. Week 10: 1500m continuous — full race distance! Practice your pacing strategy: start easy, build into the second half.

Tue.name: Speed Sharpening
Tue.description: 300m warmup + 8×50m fast (1:50/100m) with 45sec rest + 200m easy + 100m kick + 300m cooldown
Tue.coachNote: Short and fast. These sharpen your feel for speed without fatigue. Focus on clean turns and streamline.

Thu.name: Easy Technique
Thu.description: 200m warmup + 600m easy drills and technique + 200m kick + 200m cooldown
Thu.coachNote: Light session. Focus on long, smooth strokes. Week 12: skip or just 800m very easy.

Sat.name: Pre-Race or Race Day
Sat.description: Week 11: 400m warmup + 600m easy + 200m kick + 300m cooldown. Week 12: RACE DAY — 1500m.
Sat.coachNote: Week 11: light pre-race session. Week 12: RACE DAY. Start smooth, negative split. Count your strokes, breathe bilaterally. Trust your training — you've done the distance!

overrides.value: 300m warmup + 1500m continuous swim (race distance!) + 200m kick + 8×50m descending + 300m cooldown
RACE DAY — 1500m. Start at CSS pace, build into the second half. Trust your pacing.

trainingPlan.name: 12-Week 1500m Swim
trainingPlan.description: A 12-week plan for swimmers who can comfortably swim 400-800m continuously and want to complete a 1500m open water or pool swim. Builds session volume from 1200m to 3000m with CSS-pace intervals and race-specific endurance.
trainingPlan.goal: Complete a 1500m swim strong with consistent pacing
